title: concept density: normalize stems by stripping common affixes
description: From codex review of sutra/49: extract_stems tokenizes symbol names but doesn't strip common prefixes/suffixes. Repetitive APIs like handle_create/handle_update/handle_delete all count the shared 'handle' token, inflating diversity. AC says 'strip common prefixes/suffixes' — a frequency-based filter or TF-IDF-style weighting would improve the signal."
